exclusion_detail: Lead compound 41 (S-enantiomer, 6-aryl-4-(tetrahydropyridinyl)pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine) needs 7 reactions from commercial 4-chloro-7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine (55a): N-sulfonylation (72), iodination with HI/NaI (73), C6 bromination (74), N-desulfonylation (75), Suzuki with Boc-tetrahydropyridine boronate then Boc removal (76), Mitsunobu to the boronic ester 71c, final Suzuki to 41.

lead.why: Abstract: SAR exploration and metabolic stability optimization led to the discovery of compound 41 as a potent PRMT5 inhibitor with good selectivity.

notes: Route read from Scheme 6 and Experimental (compounds 72, 73, 74, 75, 76, 71c, 41); no SI file for this paper. other_qualifying_compounds: Scheme 1 compounds 12-15 are made in 2 steps (N-alkylation of 55a / 6-chloropurine with RBr and NaH to 56a-d, then NH3 amination in a sealed tube); 56a-d have explicit procedures. I did not check every other compound in Schemes 2-5, so the list may be incomplete.
